_readme: English casting for tools/voice_tts.js --lang en (owner 2026-10-10: an English voice version). Lines: design/voice/en_lines.csv (tools/voice_en_lines.js). Audio: assets/voice/en/<id>.ogg.

Only the voice changes: profile, style, per-line direction, fx and pitch come from design/voice/casting.json (the same character as in Japanese). profile/style here replace the Japanese-mode text only where that text talks about Japanese speech.

voice: an English (en-US) prebuilt voice from GET /v1beta/voices, chosen by its listed gender, age, pitch and tone (note = what the listing says). Every speaker has an own voice; melda and mistwitch share one on purpose (the fog imitates the witch's voice), and a boss with `speaker` in casting.json boss.cast uses that speaker's voice.
Accent: neutral General American for everyone (accent below goes into every prompt). The listing's accent of each voice is in note.

speakers = story speakers (casting.json speakers), hero = the hero's battle voices (m / f), battle = the 20 companions (casting.json battle.cast), boss = bosses with an own voice (casting.json boss.cast without speaker).

fine.note: female, high; soft, calm, soothing storyteller

rowell.note: male, 24, low; Northwest; confident and clear

lazaro.note: male, 60, low; Northwest; deep, velvety, unhurried

king.note: male, low; firm, direct, commanding (fx king lowers it)

valzard.note: male, low; gravelly, grounded (the Japanese mode uses the same English voice)

elm.note: male, 65, low; West Coast; storyteller, intimate

hazal.note: male, 45, low; West Coast; deep, velvety, unhurried

giant.note: male, low; steady (fx giant lowers it)

melda.note: female, 46, high; Northwest; textured, resonant, soothing

mistwitch.note: same voice as melda (the fog imitates her)

marina.note: female, 65, medium; West Coast; light, airy

guardian.note: male, low; firm, serious (fx guardian lowers it)

sentinel.note: male, low; even, balanced, steady (fx sentinel)

otto.note: male, 61, low; East Coast; conversational, dry humor, warm
otto.profile: Otto, the old lighthouse keeper of the harbour town Pharos, about 70: broad-shouldered, short white beard, skin weathered by the sea wind. Warm, gruff and grandfatherly; an old seaman's plain, homely way of speaking.

zaid.note: male, 53, low; West Coast; conversational, dry humor, warm
zaid.profile: Zaid, the caravan master of the oasis town Kasim, in his fifties: sun-dried, steady and responsible; sings the old star songs at the campfire; plain, unhurried older man's speech.

jorn.note: male, 55, low; Northwest; warm and engaging
jorn.profile: Jorn, the chief of the snow village Yule, about sixty; broad, weathered and dependable, carries the village through the midwinter fire festival and the siege; plain older man's speech.

mayor.profile: Oswald, the mayor of the lake town Loch, about sixty; stern and careful, presides over the town assembly.
mayor.style: stern, measured older male voice, about sixty; the chair of a tense town assembly

zakuro.profile: Zakuro, a hired fighter attached to the Archive, in his thirties; laconic and blunt but strictly honourable (never reads other people's letters); rough-spoken.
zakuro.style: low, dry adult male voice, about thirty-five; blunt and terse, quietly honourable

dokka.profile: Dokka, a 52-year-old stocky smith of the mountain folk; stubborn, loud, old-fashioned speech.

bartolo.note: male, 62, low; West Coast; storyteller, crisp
bartolo.profile: Bartolo, a 63-year-old veteran knight; proud, old-fashioned, a bad back.

viola.note: female, 25, low; East Coast; light, airy, precise (a fashion consultant: vain about clothes)

ferno.note: male, 42, low; Northwest; resonant and witty

boden.profile: Boden, a 61-year-old mining engineer; spry, boastful, old-fashioned.

teo.note: male, 27, high (the only high male listed); Northwest; cocky

morga.note: female, 40, low; East Coast; deep, velvety, unhurried

marta.note: female, 35, medium; Midwest; confident and clear

b_shade_star.note: female, 29, high; Midwest; confident and clear

b_ouroboros.note: male, low; lively, animated (fx lowers it)

b_tamer.note: male, 35, low; Midwest; energetic, colorful, fast
